segments.name: Home Finance
segments.description: Provides home ownership services to consumers, including purchase and refinance mortgages, home equity lending and related real estate and insurance services.
segments.evidence: Home Finance – this segment provides home ownership services such as purchase mortgages, refinance mortgages, and home equity lines of credit and closed-end second lien loans for home purchase and refinance, including cash-out refinance and debt consolidation as well as mortgage related product offerings such as real estate services and insurance services, which includes title insurance.

segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides a range of financial products and services to consumers and small businesses in the United Kingdom through Birmingham Bank.
segments.evidence: Banking – this segment provides a range of financial products and services to consumers and small businesses through Birmingham Bank.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling the mortgage loans it originates to loan purchasers such as GSEs, banks, insurers and asset managers, and by collecting fees and interest.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell the mortgage loans we originate into a network of loan purchasers, including GSEs, banks, insurance companies, asset managers, and mortgage real estate investment trusts, and we earn revenue upon the sale of each loan.

changes.text: In 2025 the company reassessed its operating segments and reclassified the prior year period to reflect that segment reclassification.
changes.evidence: The prior year period presented was recast to reflect the impact of the preceding segment reclassification.

changes.text: The company is exiting its non-core international operations in 2025.
changes.evidence: We are in the process of exiting our non-core international operations.
